description: Team Infra's single Renovate profile, replacing the preset chain used in other contexts. Policy: automerge once CI passes, including major versions. Only the named exceptions require manual review.

packageRules.description: Pin devDependencies to exact versions instead of ranges, across every repo - not just libraries. Regular (prod) dependencies keep Renovate's default rangeStrategy.
React major versions need manual review before merging.
Group all minor/patch/digest updates that can be automerged into one PR, so automerge doesn't turn into a wall of single-dependency PRs.
packageRules.groupName: non-major dependency updates that can be auto-merged

packageRules.description: Docker and java-version datasources don't provide a releaseTimestamp, so Renovate can't apply the usual stability/age check before automerging. Group them separately and require manual merge.
packageRules.groupName: non-major dependency updates that must be manually merged

packageRules.description: Group core GitHub Actions into one PR so they don't each show up separately.

Bundle all Node.js version references (.node-version/.nvmrc, package.json engines) into one PR, since Renovate tracks each as a separate manager by default - grouped, the whole bump is safe to automerge as one unit.
Cap @types/node to the current Node major so its types don't drift ahead of the runtime. Bump this when the org's target Node LTS changes.
Jackson packages release in lockstep - group them into one PR.
Testcontainers modules release in lockstep - group them into one PR.
kotlinx-serialization modules release in lockstep - group them into one PR.

http4k is a monorepo - group its modules into one PR.
jdbi3 modules release in lockstep - group them into one PR.
spek2 modules release in lockstep - group them into one PR.

Kotlin compiler/plugin/stdlib modules release in lockstep - group them into one PR.
Prevent inheriting any auto-merge of Kotlin minor versions to minimize compatibiliity issues
Avoid updates such as from 0.20.0 to 0.20.0-1.3.70-eap-274-2
Skip the normal 3-day wait for internal libraries and capralifecycle/actions-lib.
ts-jest and @types/jest release in lockstep - group them into one PR.
